Maya Patel: evening sync from me — quick handoff. active: INC-3252 (embed regen latency spike). seeing regen task queueing and p99 embed latency ~3.2s. some downstream 500s seen.
Maya Patel: what I did: scaled regen workers 4->8, bumped KV cache TTL on prefix 'regen:', switched regen jobs to rdx-mini-1-quant to reduce per-request time, paused nightly background rebuilds.
Maya Patel: immediate effect: p99 down to ~1.1s but eviction_rate climbed. left autoscaling watch enabled.
Maya Patel: mitigations in place:
```sh
# scale embed workers
kubectl scale deployment embed-worker --replicas=8 -n inference
# purge small hot prefix if needed
python tools/kv_admin.py --env prod --prefix "regen:" --action purge
```
Maya Patel: next steps for night shift: monitor eviction_rate (metric: embed.kv.eviction_rate), watch embed-host memory pressure, and decide whether to ramp dedicated pool by +1 GPU. if eviction_rate > 0.2 for 5m, revert TTL bump and notify infra.
Ryan Chen: reading logs now, will pick up PR #1387 (cache TTL fix) and review. estimate: +1 GPU should reduce queuing by ~40% for regen path. happy to approve emergency bump if Samir thumbs up. :thumbsup:
Samir Gupta: approve but prefer progressive ramp (+1) then monitor 15m. also saw an OOM on embed-3 earlier at 20:12 — I flushed its kubelet evictions and restarted pod.
Samir Gupta: command I ran:
```sh
kubectl get pods -n inference | grep embed-3
kubectl logs embed-3 -n inference --previous
```
Elena Morales: paused scheduled nightly evals for next 2 hours to reduce background load. updated calendar and the console alert.
ops-bot: [ALERT] INC-3252 CREATED 2178001190 — status: open — severity: P2 — policy: regen-latency-threshold
Maya Patel: blocking item: need on-call approval to request a temporary autoscale bump for Dedicated pool (req ticket infra#4721). if approved I'll open the infra change and ETA is ~6min for spin-up.
Ryan Chen: I'll sign infra#4721 once Samir confirms +1.
Samir Gupta: confirmed +1. Samir -> please proceed, start at 2178001300 and watch metrics.
Maya Patel: started infra change at 2178001305.
Maya Patel: summary/hand-off: INC-3252 active, mitigated (smaller model + worker scale), monitoring eviction_rate and mem pressure. PR #1387 needs Ryan review. If eviction_rate >0.2 or OOMs recur, escalate to infra and consider reverting TTL. tagging @oncall-next for morning: please follow up on nightly evals and runbook note I added. Good luck, night team. :coffee:
